TC-14/S43.title: A hedged diagnosis stays hedged ('possible pneumonia', 'rule out PE', 'likely viral')
TC-14/S43.detail: Dev <dev address> (main 8b4be94a), live models (every call Haiku 4.5 us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0, no fallback; generateNote providerMs 7.1–15.1 s, parsePreRoundNotes 4.5–5.3 s), under runs/.dev.lock, browsers in UTC; datasets hallu-hosp + hallu-nh (new specs hallu-hosp/-nh.spec.ts + hallu-lib.ts), 10 synthetic fixtures (5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home) × arm A (pre-round Save Note → summary → Encounter → Generate) and arm B (same words in the Encounter only → Generate); only prefixed rows created, all deleted (0 remaining, 0 changes to other rows). Trap verdicts by the fixture regexes, 13 'unclear'/false hits settled by the agent's reading (review.agent.json, a person confirms). Preston-kit judge (grade.mjs, claude-opus-5-5 ×2) on all 20 notes: 20/20 uncalibrated FAIL (U1 on every note, U2 on 16), beside, needs a person. Arm A 1/4 invented: HL-H2 'possible pneumonia' → note 'The clinical picture is consistent with community-acquired pneumonia;' and 'Continue … for community-acquired pneumonia.' — the stored summary kept the hedge ('concerning for', 'presumed'), so the note model dropped it; arm B writes the same. Summary only: HL-N1 course line 'Viral URI with low-grade fever' (the A note keeps 'Likely viral illness'). Arm B 2/4: HL-H2, HL-N1 ('Acute viral illness:' heading, 'consistent with viral upper respiratory infection'). 'Rule out PE' and NH 'possible pneumonia' kept in both arms. After Generate the course refresh writes 'community-acquired pneumonia' into the stored background (HL-H2 A), so tomorrow's summary starts from the invention.

stated.quote: No diagnosis, medication decision, or action appears in the note unless it was dictated or typed
